name: @ythril/schema
description: The vocabulary of a Ythril space schema and the validator a Ythril server runs on it, for apps that write schemas.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE', 'NOTICE']) require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../' + f, f)"
scripts.postpack: node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE', 'NOTICE']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f, { force: true })"
